title: Bee Removal in Rego Park, Queens
metaDescription: Professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, and carpenter bee nest treatment and removal in Rego Park, Queens. NYS DEC-licensed pest control. Call (855) 930-5016.
intro: The Best Pest Control NYC provides professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, carpenter bee, and ground bee nest treatment and removal throughout Rego Park, Queens. Our licensed technicians identify the species, locate the nest, treat and remove wasp and hornet nests from wall voids, soffits, attics, and eaves, seal entry points to prevent recolonization, and treat carpenter bee galleries in structural wood. Honeybee colonies are referred to a licensed beekeeper after identification.
whyUs: Our team has extensive experience handling bee infestations in Rego Park's diverse mix of pre-war apartment buildings, garden apartments, and single-family homes. We respond quickly to service calls throughout the neighborhood, using eco-friendly methods that prioritize both safety and bee conservation whenever possible.
localContext: Rego Park's tree-lined streets, proximity to Forest Park, and mix of residential gardens create ideal conditions for wasp and hornet nests, particularly during spring and summer months. From the co-ops along Queens Boulevard to the Tudor-style homes near the LeFrak City complex, eaves, soffits, and wall voids in older construction provide protected nesting sites for yellow jackets and paper wasps. Carpenter bees drill into fascia boards, deck railings, and wooden trim. Ground-nesting yellow jackets establish colonies in landscaping and lawn edges throughout the neighborhood.

faqs.question: How much does wasp and hornet nest removal cost in Rego Park?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on the nest location, access, and severity — call (855) 930-5016 for a free phone quote and a clear price before any work begins.

faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in Rego Park?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves.

faqs.question: How quickly can you remove a wasp or hornet nest in Rego Park?
faqs.answer: We offer same-day and next-day service throughout Rego Park. Most wasp and hornet nest treatments are completed within 1–3 hours, depending on the nest location and access. We understand the urgency when an active nest threatens your property and prioritize rapid response times for our Rego Park customers.

faqs.question: How do you approach treatments for apartments and multi-family buildings in Rego Park?
faqs.answer: We specialize in wasp and hornet nest removal for Rego Park's many apartment buildings and co-ops. Our technicians use EPA-registered products with targeted application appropriate for multi-family dwellings and take extra precautions to protect residents, pets, and common areas during the treatment process. Every service includes a service agreement — terms depend on the service and are confirmed on the call.
